Enhances AI development at the edge with next-generation HP Z workstations, hybrid AI infrastructure, and high-performance compute built for advanced local workflows. Strengthens security leadership with HP TPM Guard — the world’s first hardware solution to stop physical BitLocker bypass attacks. Unveils new LaserJet devices designed to accelerate document digitization with AI‑powered workflows and quantum‑resistant security. Expands workflow automation through Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) enhancements and connected HP Build Workspace capabilities. Elevates player potential for competitive play with new HyperX OMEN desktops, expanded OMEN AI game support and enhanced OMEN Gaming Hub capabilities.
